data.name: House of Velez part 1
data.detailed_description:
BEFORE YOU PURCHASE THIS GAME- HOUSE OF VELEZ REQUIRES A CONTROLLER TO PLAY. IF YOU DO NOT HAVE A CONTROLLER THE GAME WILL NOT WORK. XBOX LAYOUT PREFERRED.

Lily Velez, daughter of famous archaeologist Victor Velez, returns home to her family's estate following news of her father's sudden disappearance. Intent on finding clues to her missing father's whereabouts, and evidence to prove his innocents involving a scandal within his company, Lily begins her search. However, she is about to uncover something that will take her far beyond her own investigation. Something that will force her to fight for her very survival. Follow Lily into her own worst nightmare as she uncovers the dark and sadistic history that lies within the walls of the House of Velez.

House of Velez is a horror game based around stealth/puzzle elements. It emphasizes sneaking, running and hiding mechanics to surpass obstacles rather than combat.

The game features a "Focus Mode" that allows you to see your pursuers' field of vision and hearing radius, while also monitoring your own noise levels.

Another feature is "Heart Rate Suppression" that restricts movement, but allows you to become "invisible" when used effectively.

House of Velez draws inspiration from titles like Haunting Ground and even film such as the 1980's Hellraiser.

reviews.review:
This review is both for part 1 and 2.

This game is absolute peak and in my opinion criminaly underrated. I love the art style of this game it makes the game much more creepier. The game is quite difficult in some aspects and in all honesty I had to get some help through video playthroughs but language barrier played a big role in it.
The gameplay feels nice and the story has a nice pacing and the lore is really interesting. While playing you never know what disturbing thing will come next and walking through a ordinary corridor is still a pretty anxious experience. The heart rate suppresion mechanic is fine and makes the game a lot more intense while dodging enemies for the first few times but after a while it can get frustrating and also it isn't very comfortable to hold three buttons while pressing a fourth one.

However theres something else to mention and it won't be praise. I'm usually fine with „drawn“ and „cartoon“ gore and this game isn't hyperrealistic in any means, but certain deaths in this game smell of fetishization of extreme violence on women which slighty (more) fucks the game reputation. The games atmosphere, the story all of this is great but a lot of people aren't exactly happy with the portrayal of some deaths. I will write a citation I saw online under this topic: „You can appreciate an art piece that is objectively disturbing without the need to actually praise the acts shown themselves...“

For ~8€ it's more than enough gameplay and the fact that it has two diffrent endings gives it a better replayability. 

The second part also takes everything the first game had and turns it to 300%.

Can recommend to everybody who likes horror and is fine with a little blood ;)

(Can't wait for the remake also)
